tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on it; no gradients.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Raised panels: cards, drawers, decision sheets. Separated from surface-000 by hairline, never by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Inset fields and table header rows on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-000, surface-100, surface-200 (≥ 12:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps on all surfaces (≥ 4.5:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders and dividers. The only way surfaces are separated.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: links, primary action, focus ring, selected state, the cornerstone in the mark. Text on surface-000 ≥ 5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an accent fill; on-accent stays the text color on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active tab ground. ink stays the text color on it.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Succeeded, approved, verified. Always paired with a word or check glyph, never hue alone.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs a person: needs_human, blocked, budget near limit. Paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, cancelled, destructive action. Paired with a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Wordmark, page titles on the cover and the empty state. Rare.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per page: the page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: All snapshot tests pass on both device sizes.
styles.usage: Running text, decision sheet rows, ticket content. Measure ≤ 68 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above values and in chips.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Identifiers, labels as text, commands, evidence output, costs in tables (tabular numerals).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, chip padding vertical.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; chip padding horizontal.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside inputs and buttons (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, between rows of a sheet; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop; above a page title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major blocks on the cover and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, checkboxes, code spans. The default: the system is nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Drawers, modals, the cover blocks. Nothing rounder exists.

duration.note: Motion is slow and unobtrusive: it confirms a state change, never decorates. Nothing bounces, nothing loops. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration is 0.

tokens.name: duration-state
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, chip and status changes, row highlight.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Drawers, sheets, step nodes appearing in the run graph.

tokens.name: duration-page
tokens.usage: Page-level transitions only: opacity 0→1 of a view after data arrives.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every entrance and state change. Elements may move at most 8px while fading in.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only, at half the entrance duration.
